metadata.title: ढाक बजता है तो देवता भी झूमते हैं | Dhak Music of Madhya Pradesh Adivasis | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Adivasis of central India have a very rich culture and tradition. Many festivals are celebrated by these tribes. Bhil, one of the largest tribes in the state of Madhya Pradesh also celebrates several festivals throughout the year. During our visit to Madhya Pradesh we got a chance to talk to the elders of this tribe and got a better understanding of their culture, music and festivals.
#adivasi_music #dhak
